_notes: Curriculum index for PhysicsLab. Consumed by the AI tutor backend — see backend/prompts/momentum.txt, section 3 — and later by the curriculum map pages.
POPULATE ONLY FROM OFFICIAL SOURCE DOCUMENTS. The College Board AP Physics Course and Exam Description PDFs, and the IB Physics Guide (first teaching 2023). Nothing else counts as a source.

DO NOT PARAPHRASE AND DO NOT INVENT. Unit names, topic names and equations are copied as they appear in the official document, not reworded. If a field cannot be filled from an official source, leave it empty rather than guessing. A wrong syllabus reference in a tutor answer can cost a student exam marks.

POPULATION ORDER: momentum-adjacent topics first — kinematics, forces, energy, impulse, and circular motion. These are the topics a momentum question is most likely to cross into, and the tutor needs them before its topic citation rule can mark anything as 'not yet covered' accurately.

Full population happens incrementally as more simulations are built. An empty or partial index is expected. Until this file is populated, backend/prompts/momentum.txt carries an inline topic roster that stands in for it; once populated, this file supersedes that roster in full.

EQUATIONS ARE LATEX so the frontend can render them with KaTeX. JSON requires every backslash to be escaped, so a LaTeX \Delta p is stored with a doubled backslash here and reaches KaTeX as a single one. Symbol choice must match the AP formula sheet and the IB data booklet — no substitutions.
covered_by lists simulation slugs, matching the folder names under src/simulations/ and the /sim/<slug> routes. The only live simulation today is "momentum".

_schema.id: Unique kebab-case slug for this topic entry. Stable once assigned — related_topics elsewhere in the file point at it.
_schema.course: One of: "IB Physics SL/HL", "AP Physics 1", "AP Physics 2", "AP Physics C: Mechanics", "AP Physics C: E&M".
_schema.unit: Unit name exactly as it appears in the official document. IB uses lettered sections ("A. Space, time and motion"); AP uses numbered units ("Unit 4: Linear Momentum").
_schema.topic: Specific topic name exactly as it appears in the official document.
_schema.description: One-line summary of what the topic covers. This is the one field written rather than copied — keep it to a single sentence.
_schema.equations: Array of LaTeX strings, backslashes escaped for JSON. Empty array if the official document lists none for this topic.
_schema.covered_by: Array of simulation slugs that teach this topic. ["momentum"] where the momentum simulation covers it, [] where nothing does yet.
_schema.related_topics: Array of other topic ids in this file. Used to guide a student from one topic to the next; leave empty rather than forcing a link.
